moved.sentence: Adapt to the host idiom — navigation patterns, control shapes, default density, and haptics — rather than forcing one platform's look onto another.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD with all four idiom aspects and the not-forcing-one-platform's-look contrast.

moved.sentence: Centralized design-system tooling (token build pipelines, multi-target generators) is an adopt-when-measured-need-justifies investment (per YAGNI): start with a single shared file and per-platform transforms; add heavier infrastructure only when token volume or platform count makes it pay off.

judged.note: Kept: the adopt-when-measured-need-justifies framing (per YAGNI), start with a single shared file plus per-platform transforms, and add heavier infrastructure only when volume or platform count pays off, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Use the W3C Design Tokens Community Group format (DTCG), which reached its first stable version, [2025.10](https://www.w3.org/community/design-tokens/2025/10/28/design-tokens-specification-reaches-first-stable-version/), in October 2025; pin to a dated revision so one source feeds Style Dictionary or an equivalent transform per platform.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD with the DTCG 2025.10 stable version and link, the dated-revision pin and the one-source-feeds-per-platform-transforms reason.

moved.sentence: Adapt the same numeric intent to each platform's density-independent unit.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD: the same numeric intent in each platform's density-independent unit.
The unkeyed 'Do not ship raw px everywhere' is kept at SHOULD NOT.
